column3: No permission grants, per-call approvals or sandbox: a plugin is trusted code that runs
column4: the owner finds approval and capability ceremony overengineered and annoying; in-process code cannot be confined by a declaration, so a grant would be an audit form without a boundary. Installing the build is the real trust decision
column5: the first draft had permissions, plugin.grant/revoke, consent cards and an enable gate; all were removed before landing, along with the files permission annotation and the swap.test grant; 09-plugins.md has a Dropped for simplicity table
column6: cut; a sandbox returns only if a concrete use case needs it
